article.story: NEW HAVEN, Conn. -- — Samson Aletan scored 19 points to help Yale defeat Howard 93-65 on Wednesday. Aletan had five rebounds for the Bulldogs (7-6). John Poulakidas scored 17 points while shooting 6 for 13, including 4 for 8 from beyond the arc and added seven rebounds. Nick Townsend had 14 points and shot 4 for 10 (2 for 4 from 3-point range) and 4 of 6 from the free-throw line. The Bison (5-9) were led by Marcus Dockery, who recorded 17 points. Blake Harper added 16 points, six rebounds and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
